Release notes#

Operator spelling cleanup: shift arrows migrate to ⇐/⇒ (≪/≫ retired), and the conversion (conversion) glyph moves to ↦ (U+21A6). On the declaration side, let x gains an optional initializer that desugars to const _ x, and the unenforced fixus post-name marker is removed.

Scale#

SignalCount
Commits (no merges)14
Date span2026-06-24 → 2026-06-25

Major tracks#

Shift arrows (⇐/⇒) and conversion (↦) glyph migration#

Retire ≪/≫ as scan errors. Conversio vacates ⇒ so the double-arrow pair hosts bitwise shifts; the runtime conversion operator moves to ↦ (U+21A6, "rightwards arrow from bar"). Updates span the lexer, parser, Faber codegen roundtrip, HIR node types, AST, EBNF, exempla, and MIR tests (31f312d27).

let x as inferred deferred immutable#

The let initializer is now optional: let x desugars to const _ x — the inferred deferred immutable — completing symmetry with the init-now let x ← v shape. EBNF updated to sitDecl := 'sit' IDENTIFIER ('←' expression)?, parser guards removed, and definite-assignment tests added (c18840350).

fixus post-name declaration marker removed#

Drop the unenforced fixus keyword from lexer through HIR and Faber emit. The parser rejects lingering spellings with a migration diagnostic. Deletes the fixus exemplum, refreshes optional frontmatter, and aligns EBNF, README, factory docs, and reference-pack term counts (4822950d0).

Other changes#

  • Expand const/sit deferred-init coverage with parser and definite-assignment edge-case tests for typed and inferred deferred immutables, including partial-branch rejection and compound-assignment rules (b9c6ec770)
  • Clear clippy warnings (duplicate test attribute, unused import, needless mut bindings) surfaced by -D warnings during glyph migration validation (4f40f8323)
  • Update README: add inline JSON value example contrasting JSON colon syntax with class equals construction (53a8bca2a); expand glyph inventory to the full lexer surface (ee6d427b0); align user-facing examples with ↦ conversion and ⇐/⇒ shifts (791db253a)
  • Close out factory delivery doc headers for MIR M-001, semantic passes P1–P3a, compiler vocabulary consistency, value unification policy, and library import provenance (c8e5758a2)
  • Close out forma parameterized templates delivery — literal-family Stage 3 (e521ddfd8)
  • Close out inline JSON value delivery — literal-family Stage 6 (135fb2732)
  • Close out literal, exempla, and hygiene doc tracks — Stage 7 (87063aab9)
  • Archive superseded stdlib-data-formats factory track to docs/factory/archive/ (5c58a3b8f)
  • Close out shift-arrows-and-conversio-glyph factory goal — zero deviations from plan confirmed (9d2b3c08d)
